scope.purpose: Compare locally preserved, explicit ingredient declarations and catalog fact-source text with the versioned intact botanical fixed-oil reference. This is not a market-completeness claim or a weight-prior recommendation.
not_evidence: No live database or web query was performed by this inventory.
Catalog source_text is preserved commercial fact evidence supplied from a prior read-only extraction; it is not freshly verified formula authority.
The 371 catalog-product total is not formula coverage: only 94 fact-evidence rows for 85 products held stored INCI-bearing source text.

finite_source_universe.method: Parsed 568 JSON files and inspected 535 raw_inci/rawInci fields; deduplicated repeated artifact copies by exact formula string for the counts below.
finite_source_universe.evidence_quality: local declared-formula corpus; a record can be a calibration, blind, replay, or source capture artifact and does not itself establish current market formula status

finite_source_universe.method: 94 preserved catalog fact-evidence rows, representing 85 products, searched only in source_text and inci_basis text.
finite_source_universe.evidence_quality: untrusted stored commercial-source text; product-level, but stale/unverified here

finite_source_universe.method: Used only to distinguish an exact identity/role already recognized locally from product-declaration evidence.
finite_source_universe.evidence_quality: lexicon or standards mention; never counted as product-formula prevalence

missing_intact_fixed_oil_identities.lexicon_status: already admitted as botanical_fixed_oil in ingredient-lexicon-supplement.json; absent only from weight reference

missing_intact_fixed_oil_identities.caveat: The preserved calibration formula does not expose a product identity at that record; acquire independent identity evidence before any reference admission.
Observed declaration is a common-name form, not a species/plant-part INCI. Do not silently create a BRASSICA NAPUS alias.

exact_identity_or_alias_gaps_not_safe_to.evidence: catalog source text at lines 38, 495, 1477, 1760; leave-in corpus slot-01

reference itself says not to map Coconut Fruit Oil

excluded_or_boundary_forms: BUTYROSPERMUM PARKII BUTTER and THEOBROMA CACAO SEED BUTTER: intact botanical butters; outside this fixed-oil reference.
BRASSICA CAMPESTRIS/ALEURITES FORDI OIL COPOLYMER, PEG-40/60 HYDROGENATED CASTOR OIL, HYDROGENATED CASTOR/COCONUT/VEGETABLE OIL, and Hydrogenated Olive Oil Unsaponifiables: modified/derivative forms.
PSEUDOZYMA EPICOLA/CAMELLIA SINENSIS SEED OIL FERMENT EXTRACT FILTRATE, OLUS OIL, and Shea Butter Ethyl Esters: ferment, mixture, or ester forms requiring a separate identity policy.
Citrus, rosemary, mint, juniper, patchouli and similar leaf/peel oils: essential/aromatic oils, excluded.
Silicones, mineral oil, squalane, and synthetic esters/carriers: excluded material families.
non_actions: No weight prior, frozen run, matching rule, lexicon, or consumer behavior was changed.
No claim is made that the reference covers all oils in the market or all catalog products.
